summary: Iteration 400 - FINAL delta fix verification. Confirmed /api/staff/appointments/walk-in now correctly enforces doctor leave-block (returns HTTP 400 with 'on leave' detail), and /api/staff/appointments/emergency intentionally bypasses the leave block (returns 200 even on blocked date). Ran 5/5 pytest cases PASS including light regression on /api/appointments and /api/diagyn-staff/appointments/book (both correctly reject blocked date + accept open date). This closes the last remaining gap flagged in iteration_399 - all 9 booking write paths across the codebase now consistently honor the leave-block policy (with only EMERGENCY endpoints intentionally bypassing per approved design).
action_items: REMIND USER: Preview backend now fully consistent - production nevikacura.com STILL needs redeploy for user to observe the fix. This has been the persistent user-visible pain across 5 iterations and is a deployment task, not a code task.
critical_code_review_comments: staff.py walk-in fix cleanly re-uses assert_slot_not_blocked() via deferred import (line 298-299) consistent with the pattern established in iterations 397/398/399.
Emergency bypass is now explicitly documented in code (line 421 comment) - good defensive design decision, matches diagyn_staff EMERGENCY policy.

Consider consolidating leave-block enforcement into a FastAPI dependency or middleware in future to eliminate the need to remember to call assert_slot_not_blocked() in each new booking endpoint - this 5-round cycle demonstrates the drift risk of the current per-endpoint check pattern.
staff.py is 1600+ lines - candidate for splitting (walk-in/emergency, sonography, pharmacy, feedback are distinct concerns).
seed_data_creation: Block for TODAY created + torn down. Test appointments created with TEST_-prefixed names and unique per-run phone numbers (7775-7779 series); teardown deletes them via /api/appointments cleanup loop.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full leave-block enforcement matrix now verified across 9 endpoints: /api/appointments, /api/appointments/guest, /api/appointments/{id}/reschedule, /api/diagyn-staff/appointments/book (SCHEDULED type only), /api/chatbot/book, /api/voice-booking/confirm-booking, /api/features/voice/book-appointment, /api/staff/appointments/walk-in. EMERGENCY endpoints (/api/diagyn-staff EMERGENCY type + /api/staff/appointments/emergency) intentionally bypass. Regression tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_leave_block_new_endpoints_399.py and /app/backend/tests/test_walkin_emergency_leave_block_400.py - reusable for future audits.
rca of the issue: 5-round bug cycle closed. Root cause across iterations: leave-block enforcement was implemented per-endpoint rather than centrally, so each newly-discovered booking write path (grep-audit-uncovered) needed a separate patch. Iteration 400 addresses the last legacy staff.py walk-in path. Emergency was left as explicit bypass by design. Long-term mitigation: refactor into a shared FastAPI dependency invoked automatically by booking route registration.
